purpose: PINN and DeepONet pricers for one-stock Heston European options with the four Heston parameters as inputs, each built as a ladder: every level adds one technique to the configuration below it, and every level is scored on the same validation panels.
selection_rule: Within each family the level with the lowest selection score is selected. Selection score = mean of the validation score and the short-maturity validation score, each the mean over price and the 11 sensitivities of RMSE / RMS(reference) on 4,096 contracts (training domain; tau 0.005 to 0.05). A level within 1% of the best yields to the earlier level.

wall_clock_cap_seconds.note: raised from 7200 / 14400 / 14400 after P0-P10 and D0-D3 had run, when the CPU was shared by 3 levels plus pilots; levels started before the change ran with the old caps

computational_domain.note: Spatial extent of the PDE problem in x = log forward moneyness and v, like a grid solver's far boundary. kappa, theta, xi, rho and the maturity cap are the training domain; tau starts at 0 because the PDE starts at the payoff. P4 and the physics-informed DeepONet levels extend v to v_hi = 3 with c_v = 0 there, pack collocation near v = 0 and feed sqrt(v + 0.01). The ADI v_max = 15.28 (Phase 0 check 7) is not used for the networks: with the ADI solver at a fixed fine grid, c_v = 0 at v_hi = 3 moves prices at v0 <= 0.49 by at most 4e-7 against the full domain (results/neural/variance_cap_study).
